decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed in source: redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances (L88-114) verifies a static Merkle proof + EIP-712 sig but writes NO spent/nonce marker; setStalk (L206-207) uses += for stalk and roots. Proof+signature are public calldata, so the identical call is replayable until deadline, each replay re-adding unbacked stalk/roots (governance weight + earned-Bean share). Unbacked value creation = protocol insolvency, Immunefi v2.2 Critical. Canonical for the replay cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: external redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances, only fundsSafu/noSupplyChange/nonReentrant. No privileged keys: attacker replays public calldata observed on first legit redeem. State before->after: s.accts[reciever].stalk/.roots increase by accountStalk/ownerRoots on every call (assert via vm.load across N replays). Guards fail: no redeemed mapping, proof+sig re-validate identically. Scope: silo migration accounting, in scope. PoC must show N-replay stalk/roots inflation and resulting earned-Bean over-claim.

decisions.decision_reason: Same root cause, function, and path as CC-001 (no spent-marker + setStalk +=, replayable public proof/sig in redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances). Access-control lens of the identical replay bug. Merged into CC-001.
decisions.follow_up_packet: See CC-001.

decisions.decision_reason: Same root cause/function/path as CC-001 (setStalk += roots/stalk on replayable redeem). Snapshot/earned-Bean lens of the identical replay bug. Merged into CC-001.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: verifyDepositsAndInternalBalances leaf = keccak256(account, deposits, internalBalances, ownerRoots) (L127) omits reciever; destination is bound only by the EIP-712 signature (L144), which is public calldata. The immutable MERKLE_ROOT never constrains the L2 destination. Standalone a weak authorization-binding gap; chained with CC-001's replay it lets credit be redirected/duplicated to an attacker address. High. Canonical for the leaf-omits-receiver cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances. No privileged keys if a second (owner,reciever) signature is obtainable or replay (CC-001) is used. State: credit deposited to attacker-chosen reciever. Guards fail: reciever absent from committed leaf. Scope: migration. PoC: redirect a migration credit to a non-original reciever.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed in source: addMigratedDepositsToAccount declares uint128 totalDeposited/totalDepositedBdv (L159-160), never increments them, then writes them to s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited/.depositedBdv (L194-195) -- always 0 -- on every permissionless redeem. Hard assignment clobbers any prior ReseedSilo value. Breaks total==sum(accounts) invariant protocol-wide; downstream withdrawal/convert/BDV math reads the zeroed total causing underflow/DoS. Demonstrated-certain impact is protocol-wide accounting corruption/withdrawal DoS = High; an unbacked-mint escalation needs PoC. Canonical for the global-silo-zeroing cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances -> addMigratedDepositsToAccount. No privileged keys. State before->after: s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited/.depositedBdv set to 0 while s.accts[].deposits remain non-zero (vm.load both). Guards fail: locals never incremented. Scope: migration silo accounting. PoC: redeem then show global total=0 and a withdrawal reverting/underflowing.

decisions.decision_reason: Same root cause/function/lines as LG-001 (uninitialized totalDeposited/totalDepositedBdv written to global silo balances, L159-160/194-195). Behavioral-divergence lens. Merged into LG-001.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed by grep over beanstalk/init/: NO write to s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots anywhere in the reseed/init tree (only per-account s.accts[].stalk in ReseedSilo L164). After the L2 reseed, accounts hold stalk but globals are 0. Consumers: burnActiveStalk/transferStalk divide by s.sys.silo.stalk (div-by-zero revert -> withdrawal/transfer freeze), mintActiveStalk takes the roots==0 genesis branch (first mower captures disproportionate roots), _balanceOfEarnedBeans mis-scaled. Protocol-wide invariant break with no attacker required. High. Canonical for the global-stalk/roots-uninitialized cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: self-triggers on reseed; first post-migration withdraw/transfer/plant. No privileged keys. State before->after: s.sys.silo.stalk==0, s.sys.silo.roots==0 while sum(s.accts[].stalk) large. Guards fail: no init writes the aggregates. Scope: silo+sun migration completeness. PoC: post-reseed, call burn/transfer path and show div-by-zero revert, or first depositor minting genesis-scale roots.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed in source: BeanL1RecieverFacet EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS=0 (L22); recieveL1Beans does migratedL1Beans += amount then require(EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS >= migratedL1Beans) (L40), i.e. require(0 >= positive), always false for amount>0, so C.bean().mint (L43) is unreachable. The companion L1 path burns Beans before relaying. Provable by inspection (no PoC ambiguity). Permanent per-migrant fund loss: L1 burn succeeds, L2 mint always reverts. High (Critical-class only if the L1 burn->relay path is live and reachable, which depends on deployment; conservative standalone severity is per-user permanent fund loss = High). Canonical for the cap=0 cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: recieveL1Beans, callable only by the L2 BRIDGE relaying an L1 burn (no attacker needed; honest migrant). No privileged keys (the user initiates on L1). State before->after: L1 Beans burned, migratedL1Beans incremented, L2 mint reverts -> net Bean loss. Guards fail: hardcoded cap 0. Scope: cross-chain Bean migration. Inspection-proven; PoC optional once the L1->L2 relay path is live.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed in source: ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit L164 `s.accts[deposits.accounts].stalk = accountStalk` is a plain assignment, and init() calls it once per token (bean, beanEth, beanWstEth, bean3Crv, urBean, urBeanLp) over the same account keys. Any multi-token holder is overwritten on each subsequent pass, retaining only the last token's (urBeanLp) stalk. Sibling L2ContractMigrationFacet.setStalk uses += confirming the intended semantics. Deterministic per-user permanent loss of governance weight + earned-Bean share for the common multi-token holder. Provable by inspection. High. Canonical for the stalk-overwrite cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedSilo.init at migration. No attacker; deterministic for any 2+ token holder. State before->after: final s.accts[account].stalk == only last-token stalk, prior tokens' stalk discarded. Guards fail: = instead of +=. Scope: silo reseed completeness, launch-blocking. Inspection-proven.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed in source: ReseedField.init inner loop header L49 `for (uint j; j < accountPlots[i].plots.length; i++)` increments outer i, not inner j. j never advances and i runs out of bounds -> revert (or non-terminating before OOB). Any reseed input containing plots reverts, so the one-shot Field migration cannot complete. Per policy, a one-shot init/migration routine that reverts is a launch blocker and at least High. Provable by inspection. Standalone (no live duplicate among the 48 bundles).
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedField.init during diamondCut migration. No attacker; deterministic on any plotted input. State before->after: init reverts, Field never migrated. Guards fail: wrong loop counter. Scope: migration completeness, launch-blocking. Inspection-proven.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed in source (LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice L45-47): `lookback > 0 ? getPrice(...) : getTwap(..., lookback)` is inverted vs NatSpec (L34-37: lookback>0 = TWAP). A TWAP request returns spot; a spot request calls getTwap(...,0) which divides by lookback=0 (revert), also breaking the documented 0-on-frozen sentinel. Behavioral divergence is real. HOWEVER FL-002 establishes via negative trace that this Chainlink branch does NOT feed the live sunrise/deltaB mint (live BEAN:WETH/WSTETH wells price via LibEthUsdOracle/LibWstethUsdOracle, not this inverted branch), so flash-loan mint manipulation is not reachable today. Latent oracle-correctness/availability bug -> Medium (downgraded from claimed High). Canonical for the inverted-ternary cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: any consumer of getTokenPrice with lookback>0 expecting a TWAP; not currently the live mint path (per FL-002). No privileged keys. State: returns spot instead of TWAP, or div-by-zero on lookback==0. Guards fail: inverted branch. Scope: oracle library; impact latent until a consumer routes a financial decision through this branch.

decisions.decision_reason: Same root cause/function/lines as BSA-001 (inverted lookback ternary in LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice). Deep-trace/oracle lens. Merged into BSA-001.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: getTokenPriceFromExternal encodeType 0x01 returns 1e24.div(LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice(...)) (L120-127) with NO zero-guard, while the WETH/WSTETH branches guard price==0. LibChainlinkOracle returns 0 (not revert) on a broken/frozen feed, so 1e24/0 reverts instead of degrading to the documented 0 sentinel, DoSing any consumer (peg/sunrise/convert pricing) of a 0x01 token during a feed outage. Conditional, external-feed-gated temporary DoS = Medium. Canonical for the oracle div-by-zero cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: getUsdPrice/getTokenPriceFromExternal for a 0x01-registered token during a Chainlink outage. No attacker (feed condition). State: revert instead of 0-sentinel. Guards fail: missing zero-check before division. Scope: oracle; bounded to non-live 0x01 tokens, so Medium not High.

decisions.decision_reason: Same root cause/function/lines as DS-003 (missing zero-guard before 1e24/price in getTokenPriceFromExternal 0x01 branch -> div-by-zero DoS on frozen feed). Arithmetic lens. Merged into DS-003.
decisions.follow_up_packet: See DS-003.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: ReseedInternalBalances.setInternalBalances iterates i over farmers.length and reads balances[i] with no farmers.length==balances.length precondition; a short balances array reverts OOB, aborting the internal-balance reseed step (a longer one is caught by the totalInternalBalance guard). Privileged one-shot upgrade input, recoverable by resubmitting correct data. Best-practice/robustness Low. Canonical for the internal-balances length-check cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedInternalBalances.init (privileged migration caller). No external attacker. State: OOB panic aborts the reseed step. Guards fail: missing length-equality require. Scope: migration robustness; recoverable. Low.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: ReseedBarn.mintFertilizers builds the nextFid linked list (fertFirst, nextFid[prev]=cur, fertLast) assuming ascending fertilizerIds, a 'MUST' stated only in NatSpec and never enforced. Out-of-order/duplicate input produces a malformed/cyclic list that strands or mispays Sun fertilizer payouts (Beans paid in id order). Bounded to trusted upgrade-caller input -> Medium per Immunefi v2.2 (incorrect protocol behavior/payout griefing). Canonical for the fertilizer-ascending-order cluster.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedBarn.init (privileged). No external attacker. State: nextFid chain skips/loops -> fertilizer holders past the break unpaid. Guards fail: NatSpec 'MUST' unenforced by code. Scope: migration/barn payout. Medium.

decisions.decision_reason: Same root cause/function as BSA-005 (mintFertilizers does not enforce ascending fertilizerIds -> malformed/cyclic linked list). Deep-trace lens. Merged into BSA-005.
decisions.follow_up_packet: See BSA-005.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibGauge.getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv computes stalk.div(totalBdv).sub(STALK_BDV_PRECISION) with checked .sub and no floor; if stalk/totalBdv < 1e4 the subtraction reverts, and getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv -> stepGauge runs inside sunrise/gm, so every season advance reverts. The depressed-ratio precondition is reachable post-migration via the LG-001/PC-001 desync. Standalone (precondition required) = Medium temporary season-freeze DoS per Immunefi v2.2; escalates toward High when chained with the migration desync.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: sunrise/gm -> stepGauge -> getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv. No privileged keys. State: checked .sub underflow reverts the season advance. Guards fail: no floor before sub. Scope: season progression DoS. Conditional on stalk/BDV<1e4 (reachable via migration desync).

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed structure: LibFlood handleRain (flood branch) sizes SOP from getWellsByDeltaB -> currentDeltaB(well) -> getReserves (INSTANTANEOUS spot reserves, not the cumulative-pump TWAP the mint uses), then sopWell mints and swaps with minAmountOut=0 / deadline=max. Flood is permissionlessly triggerable via sunrise/gm after an Oversaturation season, so an attacker controls timing: skew the well to inflate sopBeans and sandwich the zero-slippage swap, capturing value owed to stalkholders. Permissionless economic leak = High; magnitude needs a state-flip PoC. Distinct from the mint path (FL-002 confirms mint is TWAP-defended).
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: permissionless sunrise/gm in a flood season. No privileged keys. State before->after: attacker pre-skews well reserves, sopBeans inflated, zero-minAmountOut swap sandwiched; stalkholder plenty (rewardSop) reduced. Guards fail: instantaneous reserves + minAmountOut=0. Scope: SOP economics. PoC: flash-skew well, trigger flood, measure attacker profit vs stalkholder shortfall.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibFlood.floodPodline makes ~0.1% of Bean supply of Pods harvestable each flood season, consumed FIFO. Flood is permissionlessly triggerable via sunrise after Oversaturation, so an actor who accumulates front-of-line Pods can convert a controllable flood schedule into a near-deterministic harvest stream. Bounded (0.1%/season, public priced market) -> opportunistic reward-timing edge, not theft of principal. Medium per Immunefi v2.2 (bounded griefing/MEV advantage).
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: sunrise/gm flood branch. No privileged keys. State: front pod-line positions ripen 0.1%/season to the holder. Guards fail: deterministic FIFO + permissionless flood timing. Scope: Field/flood incentives. Bounded -> Medium.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed structure: LibPipelineConvert measures before/after deltaB for the stalk penalty via uncapped instantaneous spot reserves (LibDeltaB.currentDeltaB -> getReserves, ZERO_LOOKBACK), while the convert-capacity ceiling uses the capped Multi-Flow pump. Since pipelineConvert runs attacker-supplied advancedFarmCalls between the two snapshots, the attacker can skew uncapped spot deltaB to understate against-peg movement and zero the stalkPenaltyBdv (require(stalkPenaltyBdv==0) passes), keeping more grown stalk than the capped design intends. Relative governance/yield gain, not direct unbacked mint -> Medium. Needs a PoC proving the skew zeroes the penalty. Distinct finding (safety_net=false).
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: ConvertFacet.convert / pipelineConvert. No privileged keys (flash loan). State before->after: stalkPenaltyBdv computed 0 on skewed spot reserves vs >0 on capped reserves; user retains extra grownStalk. Guards fail: penalty measured on uncapped spot, capacity on capped pump. Scope: convert accounting. PoC required to confirm magnitude/reachability.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibFlood.calculateSopPerWell final loop `for (i = positiveDeltaBCount; i > 0; i--)` executes `shaveToLevel += (shaveToLevel - uint(wellDeltaBs[i-1].deltaB)) / (i - 1)` inside the shave branch; on the last iteration i==1 so (i-1)==0 -> division-by-zero panic, reverting. calculateSopPerWell runs via LibFlood.handleRain inside sunrise/gm, so in a multi-well mixed-sign configuration where the branch is taken on the last (largest) positive well, the revert blocks that season's advancement. Conditional, configuration-dependent temporary sunrise DoS = Medium per Immunefi v2.2; currently bounded by few soppable wells. Distinct from EA-001/DS-003.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: sunrise/gm -> handleRain -> calculateSopPerWell in a flood with >=2 wells, mixed-sign deltaBs, shaveToLevel exceeding the largest positive well on the final step. No attacker required. State: div-by-zero panic reverts the season advance. Guards fail: divides by (i-1) which is 0 on i==1. Scope: season DoS. Conditional -> Medium.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: the migration EIP-712 domain uses C.getLegacyChainId() (hardcoded 1) and address(this), and the struct hash covers only (owner, reciever, deadline) -- no nonce and no destination-L2 binding. A single owner signature is valid on any L2 deployment sharing the diamond address and the hardcoded legacy chainId, and carries no nonce to bound reuse. On a single-L2 deployment the practical replay is subsumed by CC-001, but the standalone scoping weakness (multi-deployment replay + absent nonce) is a distinct authorization-scoping Medium.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: verifySignature on any L2 reusing the domain. No privileged keys (public sig). State: same sig validates across deployments. Guards fail: hardcoded chainId, no nonce, no L2 binding. Scope: cross-chain auth scoping. Medium standalone.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibUsdOracle.getTokenPrice WETH branch forwards lookback but the WSTETH branch hardcodes getWstethUsdPrice(0), dropping the caller's lookback so a TWAP request returns spot wstETH/USD. Sibling getUsdPrice forwards lookback for WSTETH, confirming this is an oversight. Weakens manipulation resistance for wstETH-priced consumers requesting a TWAP. Distinct function/token from BSA-001. Medium.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: getTokenPrice(wstETH, lookback>0). No privileged keys. State: returns spot instead of TWAP. Guards fail: hardcoded 0 lookback. Scope: oracle; impact when a consumer relies on the requested wstETH TWAP. Medium.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibWstethEthOracle.getWstethEthPrice only assigns the price inside `if (getPercentDifference(chainlink, uniswap) < MAX_DIFFERENCE)` (1%) with no else/fallback, so on >=1% divergence it returns 0. A 0 propagates as oracle-failure (getUsdPrice 0 -> minting oracle off / LibDeltaB revert), pausing BEAN:WSTETH minting and conversions exactly during volatility. Conditional availability DoS = Medium. The NatSpec describes a richer fallback policy the code does not implement.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: any wstETH-well pricing during a >=1% Chainlink/Uniswap divergence (stETH depeg/volatility). No attacker required. State: oracle returns 0 -> deltaB=0 / convert revert. Guards fail: no else branch / fallback. Scope: wstETH well availability. Medium.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibChainlinkOracle validates only roundId!=0 + timestamp/answer freshness; it never checks answeredInRound>=roundId and applies no min/max sanity bounds, and uses a 4h timeout on feeds documented as 1h heartbeat. Carried-over stale rounds within 4h and circuit-breaker pinned prices are accepted. Chainlink is a trusted source and the 0-on-failure design handles outages, so impact is a minor staleness/bounds best-practice gap = Low.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: any getPrice consumer during a stale/pinned Chainlink round. No attacker control. State: slightly-wrong price accepted. Guards fail: no answeredInRound / min-max bounds. Scope: oracle hardening. Low.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed structure: FarmFacet.farm/advancedFarm, DepotFacet pipe family, TractorFacet.tractor and LibPipelineConvert.executeAdvancedFarmCalls carry NO nonReentrant; the shared diamond guard is only set by guarded callers, so entering through one of these arbitrary-call entrypoints leaves the flag unset, allowing reentry into other unguarded state-mutating functions (sow/harvest/sunrise/mintFertilizer) mid-batch while internal accounting is transiently inconsistent. Invariable defends token custody but NOT internal accounting (stalk/deltaB/season) read mid-batch. No direct drain is traced from reentrancy alone, but this is the structural seam the economic/oracle vectors ride; cannot be cleared without a traced consumer. Medium, routed to PoC to confirm a mid-batch state-read exploit.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: FarmFacet.farm / DepotFacet.advancedPipe / TractorFacet.tractor with an attacker callback. No privileged keys. State: reentry reaches unguarded sow/harvest/sunrise/mintFertilizer while outer batch mid-execution. Guards fail: no nonReentrant on these entrypoints; Invariable only checks custody. PoC: demonstrate a mid-batch inconsistent-state read converted to value.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: TractorFacet does not inherit Invariable (FarmFacet and DepotFacet do, with fundsSafu), yet tractor() executes an arbitrary AdvancedFarmCall[] batch as the publisher with only verifyRequisition+runBlueprint and no wrapper-level fundsSafu/flow guard. Inner guarded facets re-check fundsSafu, but there is no batch-level net solvency assertion, so an interleaving solvent at each inner checkpoint yet net-adverse across the batch, or an unguarded inner sink, executes with no final check. Genuine asymmetric guard gap (defense-in-depth) = Medium. Distinct from RE-001 (guard architecture vs reentrancy seam).
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: TractorFacet.tractor with a crafted blueprint. Publisher-authorized (not arbitrary EOA against others). State: batch executes with no wrapper fundsSafu. Guards fail: TractorFacet lacks Invariable inheritance. Scope: solvency defense-in-depth. Medium.

decisions.decision_reason: Safety-net code (one-shot init/migration completeness). All Reseed*.init functions are external with NO access modifier (no onlyOwner/initializer) while performing privileged bulk global-state writes. If any init selector is registered on the diamond, or diamondCut is reachable, an attacker re-runs init to re-mint stalk/roots and re-zero global silo balances -> Critical class. The standard EIP-2535 pattern runs these once via diamondCut _init without adding selectors, which would make them unreachable, but I cannot prove the deployment/diamondCut wiring from source alone. Per the no-silent-clear rule I cannot reject this without a concrete disproof of reachability; routed to human review to confirm the selectors are not registered as live facets.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: ONLY if a Reseed init selector is added to the diamond or diamondCut is callable (unproven from source). No access modifier on the functions themselves. State: re-execution re-writes global accounting. Guards fail: no onlyOwner/initializer; relies entirely on deployment wiring. Scope: needs the deployed diamondCut/selector manifest to clear or confirm.

decisions.decision_reason: Confirmed: LibTractor._domainSeparatorV4 uses BLUEPRINT_TYPE_HASH as the domain typehash instead of the defined EIP712_TYPE_HASH, producing a non-standard domain separator. No auth bypass/replay results: the same non-standard separator is used by both signer-recovery and verifier, chainId is included, and a per-blueprint nonce with maxNonce bounds replay. Impact is standards/interoperability: signatures from standard EIP-712 tooling won't verify (self-DoS of legitimate signers). Low. Not safety-net (no protocol-protection role); valid Low correctness finding.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Reachable: any standards-compliant signer producing a Tractor blueprint signature. No privileged keys. State: signature fails to verify against the non-standard separator. Guards fail: wrong typehash constant. Scope: EIP-712 interoperability. Low.

decisions.decision_reason: Explicit negative-result documentation, not a finding: confirms the sunrise/gm deltaB mint is NOT flash-loan manipulable. Rejected as a non-vulnerability (recorded only to close the hypothesis).
decisions.disproof: To over-mint Beans in sunrise an attacker must inflate twaDeltaB within one block, but LibWellMinting.twaDeltaB reads ICumulativePump.readTwaReserves -- a season-length time-weighted average of cumulative reserves since the previous snapshot. A single-block flash-loan skew contributes negligibly to a season-length TWAP, and the minting oracle self-disables (deltaB=0) when twaReserves[beanIndex] < WELL_MINIMUM_BEAN_BALANCE or the USD oracle fails. The inverted-ternary getTokenPrice bug (BSA-001) is on the Chainlink source (not flash-manipulable) and the live BEAN:WETH/WSTETH wells price via LibEthUsdOracle/LibWstethUsdOracle, not the inverted branch, so it does not feed the live mint. Therefore no reachable single-tx path inflates the sunrise mint; the residual manipulable surface is the convert PENALTY spot path (FL-001), captured separately.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Negative result; mint path TWAP-defended. No action.

decisions.decision_reason: Not safety-net code (a defensive abs() helper, not a solvency/oracle/bridge/init guard). LibConvert.abs(int256.min) would revert on unary negation, but no reachable path produces int256.min: deltaB = calcReserveAtRatioSwap(reserves) - reserves[beanIndex] is bounded by realistic well reserve magnitudes far below 2^255. Theoretical-only, no fund loss. Rejected as Info.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Unreachable in practice; deltaB magnitudes far below int256.min. No action.

decisions.decision_reason: Not safety-net code (a reward computation, not a protocol-protection guard). LibSilo.stalkReward would only mis-behave if endStem < startStem, but every caller derives startStem from a stored deposit stem and endStem from the monotonically-increasing stemTip, and removeDepositFromAccount/grownStalkForDeposit require stem <= stemTip, so the invariant holds and the worst case is a checked-multiplication revert, not a wrong reward. Robustness gap only. Rejected as Info.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Invariant startStem<=endStem holds for all valid deposits; worst case is a checked revert. No action.

decisions.decision_reason: Not safety-net code (downcast notes). The two uint128 downcasts were re-derived: overflowing uint128 (~3.4e38) would require BDV magnitudes ~3.4e28 micro-BDV, orders of magnitude above any plausible Bean supply (~1e13 micro-Beans). Safe under realistic bounds; documented only for future-parameter caution. Rejected as Info.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Casts safe under realistic supply; no overflow path. No action.

decisions.decision_reason: Not safety-net code (token-pull accounting in a privileged-token path). LibFertilizer.addFertilizer credits the tokenAmountIn argument with a raw transferFrom and no balanceOf delta, which would drift only for a fee-on-transfer/rebasing Barn-Raise token. The Barn-Raise token is governance-controlled and currently wstETH (standard, non-FOT, reverts on failed transfer), so there is no live drift and the raw transferFrom cannot silently fail. Latent best-practice issue, no current impact. Rejected (Info-tier).

decisions.decision_reason: Not safety-net code (guard-consistency blemish). SiloFacet.safeTransferFrom/safeBatchTransferFrom omit nonReentrant relative to transferDeposit(s).
decisions.disproof: To exploit the missing nonReentrant an attacker must re-enter during the transfer, but both functions immediately route to transferDeposit, which IS nonReentrant and backed by the shared diamond reentrancy slot (s.sys.reentrantStatus); any reentry is caught by that inner guard. The functions perform no external token transfer or ERC1155 acceptance-hook callback of their own (deposits are internal accounting), so there is no callback window in which to reenter. The omission is cosmetic, not reachable.
decisions.follow_up_packet: Inner transferDeposit nonReentrant on shared slot defends; no external callback. No action.
